content_audit.finding: Text says five dimensions but the following diagram includes six (including indulgence/restraint). Correct the historical/model version distinction rather than silently retaining this mismatch.

The materials infer user motivations and design causes from country scores and screenshots without comparative user data. Present model as aggregate interpretive lens, not user persona or UI prescription.

Single/group product photos and presence of social links are described as evidence of individualism/collectivism. These images establish observed composition only; campaign, product and commercial goals provide alternative explanations.

Source describes users from feminine cultures as cooperative and feedback-giving and users from masculine cultures as quality-demanding. Do not reproduce as individual traits, sex/gender claims, or causal usability rules.

Clarity, error prevention and navigation indicators should not be withdrawn from users assigned low national uncertainty avoidance. Current source converts aggregate labels into prescriptions without task-level evidence.
Source asserts entire interface mirrors and ties this to a reversed F-pattern. Use screenshot to observe actual controls; avoid all-elements mirroring or deterministic gaze-rule claims.
Preserve concrete observations (campaign, login, QR, menu) while removing unsupported inference that product grouping, navigation or colour establishes national personalities.
Earlier course already teaches checking initial assumptions with surveys/interviews and revising personas from evidence. Use this empirical loop to connect cultural hypotheses to local user research.
